reason: A named independent lab with the report for my batch on the page is exactly what I look for, and the dose is clear with no magnesium oxide. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, and the pre-counted sachet might help me stop forgetting.
objection: It is a brand new product with no reviews yet, so I would open the lab report first to check it is real and matches the batch number. If the report is vague or the lab can't be verified, I walk away.
would_change_my_mind: A lab report I can actually open and check, plus a few real buyer reviews.
